changelog: Resolved CSRF Token Error: Automatically fetch and transmit x-codeium-csrf-token headers on all hub calls.
Added Pure Monochrome Solid White & Solid Black Theme: 100% OLED pitch black and crisp pure white with zero neon.
Unified Theme Templates: Each template now holds matching Dark & Light modes together, dynamically updating when toggling display modes.
Quick Theme Picker: Floating panel updated to display unified theme templates with real-time mode-aware color previews.
